question.text: A client wants to offset losses against gains. PMS-generated:

answer.text: Short-term capital losses can be set off against STCG and LTCG; LT losses against LTCG only

explanation.text: The Logic: STCL vs STCG and LTCG; LTCL only vs LTCG; carry forward 8 years. The Trap: Other options misstate set-off rules. Cross-Exam Context: Same in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Consider tax-loss harvesting before FY end in bearish years.
